reason: The sachet thing is actually handy, I can throw one in my gym bag and not think about it, and the lab report plus money-back thing makes it low risk at $24.99. I'd grab one box on impulse if a creator I follow showed it, but I wouldn't commit to a second yet.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I'm paying more for the sachet packaging than for anything in the capsule.
